connector.name: U2 MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Connect AI assistants to Rocket Universe/UniData MultiValue databases via MCP.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package u2-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the bpamiri account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: U2_HOST
env.description: Universe/UniData server hostname or IP address

env.name: U2_SERVICE
env.description: Service type: 'uvcs' for Universe, 'udcs' for UniData

env.name: U2_READ_ONLY
env.description: Disable write operations for safe exploration

env.name: U2_MAX_RECORDS
env.description: Maximum records returned from SELECT queries

env.name: U2_BLOCKED_COMMANDS
env.description: Comma-separated list of blocked TCL commands
